name: Telegram Desktop Accessibility
author: Ken Chang
description: Improves Telegram Desktop accessibility for NVDA users. Adds Alt+1 to move focus to the chat list, Alt+M to open Telegram's main menu, and Alt+Y, Alt+N, Alt+A and Alt+V to answer a call, hang up, mute the microphone and turn the camera on or off. The add-on uses Telegram's stable UIA class information and leaves Telegram's native accessible names unchanged.
